description: This file defines the ServiceValidationException class, a custom exception used in the Apache OFBiz framework for handling validation errors related to service operations. It extends the GenericServiceException class and includes additional fields for missing, extra, and error mode information, as well as associated getter methods.

classes.name: ServiceValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling service validation errors within the OFBiz framework, with fields for validation messages, missing/extra fields, service context, and error mode.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns the list of extra fields encountered during service validation.

methods.name: getMissingFields
methods.description: Returns the list of missing fields involved in validation errors.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of validation messages if available.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the ModelService instance associated with the exception.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related service if available.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Builds a detailed message string combining the standard message and validation messages.
